title: Portuguese Vegetable Stir Fry
description: A hearty and flavorful stir fry made with a variety of vegetables and a hint of Portuguese spices. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of Vegetable Oil in the Skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced Onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced Garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced Skillet, Bell Pepper, and Zucchini to the skillet. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5-6 minutes.
Season with Salt and Black Pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped Fresh Cilantro if desired.
